approach: Byte-matching decompilation of the DOS executables (UFO2P.EXE, TACP.EXE) with the original Watcom compiler, to document the original engine for OpenApoc. Not a port.
notes: Own matching oracle built from KKND-Decomp and Theme Hospital decomp tooling: the original Watcom C 10.6 under wibo in Docker, configure.py + ninja, an in-place LE splice with a whole-EXE SHA-1 gate, and OMF-to-ELF for objdiff. Ghidra 12.1.4 runs headless in the Docker image with the lastonesky LE loader. The agent layer is our own (Phase 6, after spike 006): a per-function Claude Code driver whose matches the build re-verifies, never the agent. Progress comes from a gate-written status table; the objdiff-shaped report is the X-COM_Apocalypse_DOS_report artifact.
